migration.legacy_rows: existing values preserved; new fields NULL; legacy reads supported

session.restore: paused, no network until explicit resume; fresh source validation/resolution; SDK seek after Ready
session.unavailable_collection_members: preserve recoverable IDs/occurrences/contexts and previous navigation; discard invalid full-cycle reconstruction

history.duration: effective decoded/SDK duration; canonical metadata unchanged
history.listening_time: observed renderer clock or SDK advancing time; rounded seconds
history.eligibility: natural end; observed duration at least 1 second; heard at least min(duration/2,240 seconds); known preview excluded
history.retry: same logical attempt; durable receipt prevents duplicate play/history, including after history deletion and restart
history.repeat: new logical attempt per completed repeat cycle
history.source_changes_on_restore: before audio only; reset position/evidence when changing origin; no union of versions

native_clock.implementation: per-voice accumulated advancing renderer position, excluding pending seek discontinuities and successor priming
native_clock.callback: scalar state and atomic publication; no new allocations or database access in audio callback

interface: active source and saved preference distinguished
source management marks source in use
history shows observed listening time and media duration
Replay uses observed duration; remote tracks remain eligible for smart playlists and statistics

new_end_to_end_cases: mixed collection repeat/shuffle/previous with duplicate occurrences and stable contexts
offline paused remote restore; source disable; seek only after Ready
logical retry receipt survives deletion/restart; repeat creates another play
last native track records without a successor; seek does not create a play
legacy history preserved; missing collection member; previous after restart
pre-audio fallback from known preview to actual local origin; saved preference preserved
validation.external_network: No live service requests needed for this stage. Host protocol fixtures, local SQLite and real WAV decoding/rendering; external smokes skipped by default.

limits: active progress may lose the last unflushed interval on abrupt termination
fallback during audio/union of segments remains a separate increment
remote scrobbling not expanded; official player capabilities remain as documented in stage 13
